blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—Barangay Ginebra gained an inside track for the last quarterfinals berth in the PBA Governors’ Cup after taking down Phoenix, 106-89, on Sunday at Ynares Center here. A run of 17 consecutive points during the second quarter enabled the Gin Kings to pull away and produce a convincing win that came after being handed a 19-point loss by the Magnolia Hotshots the previous Sunday, And by improving to a 4-5 win-loss card to overtake Meralco for fourth in Group B, Ginebra has a firm grip on its chances to make the quarters.
